source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1933, p. 7 ("County Derry elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: BNL 5 Jun 1933 p7 'County Derry elections': 'Mr. John Colboun [Colhoun] ... (U.), 224; Mr. Joseph M'Kinucy [M'Kinney] ... (U.), 20L [201]' (OCR); 486 voters, 427 polled, two spoiled (224+201+2=427).

note: Triennial rural district council election. Polling in the Tobermore division took place on Friday 2 June 1933 and the votes were counted at Magherafelt on Saturday 3 June. No other division was contested: twenty-five members were returned unopposed at the nominations on Friday 28 April 1933 (Irish News, 1 May 1933, p. 3). Filed on 1933-06-02, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1933-06-01 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Twenty-three unopposed returns added from the Irish News list (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Both Unionists. Majority 23. Of 486 voters 427 went to the poll and only two papers were spoiled.
